What makes Hubert Kos one of the world's best male backstroke swimmers?
In this episode of SwimPad with James Gibson, we take a closer look at the Hungarian star’s backstroke technique, exploring how he builds his stroke and the technical details behind his success in the pool.
James Gibson breaks down the mechanics, precision and key elements that help Kós perform at the highest level.
Dive into the details behind the performance!
